claim: Predictive landing page optimization allocates each visit (especially paid clicks) to a page variant using a model trained on outcomes — not a single fixed A/B winner for everyone.
definition: Predictive landing page optimization chooses, per visit, which approved page to show based on context and predicted outcomes, measured against a live holdout where possible.
product_description: Lutiq generates on-brand landing page variants for paid traffic, the brand owner approves what may run, and for every click the system predicts which page to show — measured against a live holdout.
caveats: Prediction without approval or holdout measurement is incomplete as a product claim.
